decisions.extraction_method: pypdf 6.10.0 page.extract_text; UTF-8; page terminator U+000C; no normalization
decisions.identity_basis: Original acquisition ZIP filename and exact PDF SHA-256 match uniquely generated publisher/date/title path from URL-bearing source rows, corroborated by multiple distinctive text anchors. Local content identity reviewed; online canonical URL not verified.
limitations: Partial text-layer recovery, not a complete article or a verified current online version.
Fixed navigation obscures page-edge text in the rendered PDF; some linked words are white/invisible. Extraction retains their original PDF text layer, with layout limitations recorded.
The page 5 infographic is an image and is not transcribed or used for numerical answers.
Cross-page fragments of the Our aim quotation and cost-comparison sentence are excluded from retrieval; no quotation is synthesized across page/navigation gaps.
Related-story links, sharing links, paid disclosure and site navigation remain in the raw extraction but are outside retained retrieval ranges.
Local source manifest plus matching content confirms the article association; the current online canonical page was not readable in this review.
